Description: A hardware design project focused on creating Arduino-compatible PCB layouts and recreating the RAMPS 1.4 3D printer controller board for learning and skill development.
Design Objectives: Learn component placement and routing strategies
Design Process: Studied reference schematics and existing board layouts
Designed PCB layout with proper component placement
Performed routing with focus on clarity and efficiency
Tools Used: PCB Design Software (e.g., Altium / EasyEDA / Proteus)
Challenges: Managing routing for dense PCB designs
Maintaining clean and readable trace paths
Balancing component placement with routing efficiency
Outcome: Successfully designed functional PCB layouts for Arduino shield and RAMPS 1.4
Gained hands-on experience in embedded hardware design
